reasoning: Basis is proposed on a proposed_book stage, so the claim is a proposal. E1 is established: from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right. The condition the Right carries appears only in agent-proposed E3 and E7. No cited item says outside apprentices are being trained or that repair is demonstrated; E3 says only that the lineages need the condition demonstrated. E6 places the labour with lineage crews under the Right. The relation is defensible as creative proposal, not as record.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: Read as record, the claim reports a training event and a demonstration that no cited item states. The claim offered no quote. E7's quote carries the condition only as agent-proposed material, and E7 also notes a reversal for the review point.
would_settle: A cited record that outside apprentices are trained under the Right and that their repair is demonstrated, or an author-adopted statement of the Right's training condition.
creative_room: The stage can still ask what the lineage would have to carry and what the labour would mean if outside apprentices train under the Right and repair is shown. Treat the training, the demonstration and the Right's condition as proposals, not record, until an author or accepted revision adopts them.

clauses.note: E7 and E3 state the condition only as agent-proposed elements; E1 establishes the Right but not its condition.

clauses.text: Outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right
clauses.note: No cited item says outside apprentices are being trained under the Right; E1 and E6 place the labour with lineage crews. Fine as a stage proposal, not as record.
E3 says the lineages need the condition demonstrated, which is a need rather than a demonstrated event.

clauses.text: so the condition the Right carries is tested
clauses.note: Holds only if the condition is real and the training and demonstration occur; the test follows from the proposed development.

defensible_possibility: Outside apprentices trained under the Right, with their repair shown in a proposed later Book, testing the training condition that E3 and E7 propose. It stays a proposal while that condition is agent-proposed.
